pair_validity_rule: Both arms must be present, run_complete, valid, and share equal initial SHA256; otherwise exclude both from paired success denominator but retain raw records.
invalid_episode_rule: Keep invalid as invalid or not_run (never silently convert to success=False); no automatic rerun of a pair or click after timeout.
analysis_rule: Report task success on valid matched pairs plus invalid/not-run coverage and CDEA comparable probes and action divergences; do not claim superiority from zero opportunities.
